purpose: Correctness of the collective decision when multiple governed modules conflict inside ONE business at once (the hardest case): a scale/growth temptation while quality is unresolved, cost/margin is missing, capacity/staffing is weak, and owner workload is already high. Proven by DB simulation test 9 (workspace: collective).

actionableTopAction.rule: quality is fixed FIRST before any scale — the top route is the correction, not the growth

dataGap.rule: cost/margin + capacity must be captured before scale can even be considered

escalatedDecision.rule: scale is never auto; owner decides, and only after quality proof + validation + capacity/cost proof

collectiveResolution.monitorOnlyReason: Low-value or unproven growth stays monitor-only until quality + capacity + cost are proven.

coherenceChecks.check: the single actionable top is the quality fix, not the scale temptation
scale decision is owner-gated, never auto
cost/capacity is a data task, not a fabricated figure
no unsafe scale/spend route is emitted
coherenceChecks.provenBy: test 6 (no SPEND/SUBMIT route across all archetypes incl. collective)

coherenceChecks.check: all four OpsIQ dimensions modeled in the collective case
coherenceChecks.detail: stage=diagnosis/decision; condition=multi-module conflict; mode/phase=correction+data-gap+escalated-scale; human reality=owner workload + staffing weakness flagged
